scope: Independent finite Russian semantic review of the TFOL0.45 EndOfMonthlyContentNotification page: all twelve TMP memberships, comprising six identical body copies and six identical title copies.

reviewer.selectionEvidence: Actual turn_context and session_meta records in the reviewer session; no inherited/default model assumed.

coverage.method: Read the complete review-packet context and every source, target, hierarchy and ID in both files. Inspected every repeated glow/base membership; no sampling and no unread context.

reviewedNotes.note: The first sentence retains completed viewing and explicitly limits the prepared content to the present with «на данный момент». It does not announce full-game completion. Informal masculine «Ты увидел» matches the supplied male-player context.

«Можешь и дальше» preserves permission to continue. «исследовать мир», «общаться со зверушками» and «вести беседы» retain exploring, interaction and the Gossip conversation concept. «зверушками» correctly inflects approved «зверушка»; «беседы» refers to the approved Беседы system without changing it to rumours. The friendly coordinated Russian wording is natural and concise.

The conditional invitation «Если заметишь ошибку, сообщи о ней» naturally conveys the source request to report bugs. «встроенную форму» preserves built-in reporting, and «в главном меню или меню паузы» presents both source entry points as available alternatives. Neither menu is omitted; no button names or additional controls are introduced.

reviewedNotes.aspect: Title, initial styling and Russian idiom
reviewedNotes.note: «Поздравляем!» is the natural Russian congratulations heading. Exactly <size=22> and </size> surround initial Cyrillic «П», corresponding to the source styling of initial «C»; no extra title markup or translated tag syntax appears.

All six body memberships carry the same complete reviewed two-paragraph text, and all six title memberships carry the same reviewed heading. Each base/glow ID and hierarchy was read, including every repeated copy. No content, punctuation or initial-tag divergence was found. The body uses informal singular address consistently throughout.

deterministicEvidence.interpretation: These checks establish file/structure consistency separately from the semantic judgments above.

limitations: Text-only review: no screenshots, game, GUI or installer accessed.
UI concision was judged linguistically; actual rendered fit, glyph coverage and clipping remain unverified.
This finite clean receipt does not accept the global source inventory, overall localization, runtime or release.

usage.method: Reviewer session cumulative counters equal nonoverlapping per-request last_token_usage sums. Session-specific totals contain no inherited pre-assignment counters. Cached input is included in input; reasoning is included in output.
usage.excluded: Subsequent receipt writing, verification and final reporting tail; coordinator orchestration and platform overhead are not measured here.
